_doc: Allowed exceptions for scripts/audit-chrome.mjs. path is a regex on the repo-relative file; kind is emoji|marker|dot (optional); match is a substring of the offending line (optional). 'pending' entries are known violations in surfaces being redesigned (council deliberation work); the script counts them and prints a reminder, delete them as each surface is converted.

entries.reason: the detector's own character classes (regex definitions), not rendered text
persona 'emoji' data field: an authored avatar value in API payloads, not rendered chrome
outbound iMessage text and masked-number hint parsing: message content, not app chrome
masked contact hint (bullets stand for hidden digits; user-authored contact data display)
